what: On a white panel, scattered worry speech bubbles: when the panel reaches the bottom of the screen, the first two are already up, then withdrawn from 4 seconds (3 on phone) at 2-second intervals. Every 1.5 seconds one at random rises from 1rem below and turns on (.3s). Any from the same group (overlapping spot) as one already up are skipped so they don’t cover each other, and each one that’s up goes down after 8 seconds (5 on phone). The newest is always on top. The scene is people murmuring Got worries like these?

options.hold: Duration a floating speech bubble stays (ms), default 8000
options.hold-narrow: Dwell time on narrow screens (ms), default 5000
options.first: Number of front items floating from the start, default 2
options.first-hold: When the first ones start to be removed (ms, 2s interval), default 4000
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-rise: On duration, curve and rise distance (via style), default .3s · ease · 1rem
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Speech bubble (child) — position comes from the user’s style (top·left…). data-group="1,2" Overlapping group via this, narrow-screen group via data-group-narrow

use:
• One-line concern
    • …
note: The original is random every time, so the order shown differs on each open

from.where: index.html .i-bubbles (fifteen worry bubbles on the WHAT WE CAN DO panel — one every 1.5s, each stays 8s on PC · 5s on phone, overlapping clusters via data-overlap-pc/-mobile)
